titel: Marinated meat turns mealy or mushy
kurz: [[enzym|Enzymes]] from pineapple, kiwi or papaya and strong acid attack the surface. Marinated too long, it turns mealy.
bild_im_kopf: Like a jumper washed too hot: the surface is never quite the same afterwards.

ursachen.titel: Raw pineapple, kiwi or papaya in the marinade
ursachen.warum: The enzymes keep cutting up protein on the surface.
fix: Marinate for half an hour to an hour at most
Or briefly boil the fruit first

ursachen.titel: Too much acid for too long
ursachen.warum: Acid cooks the surface chemically; it turns white and crumbly.
fix: Use acid sparingly; keep the marinade oily and spicy
Add acid only shortly before cooking

q1.frage: Was there pineapple, kiwi or papaya in the marinade?
